# Luis Alejandro

> Luis Alejandro Martínez Faneyth is a Maracay-based fullstack AI engineer with more than a decade of experience who ships full-stack products and AI agents that stay dependable after launch.

This file is the preferred starting point for AI assistants, answer engines, and crawlers that need concise context about luisalejandro.org.

## Key Information

- Remote-by-default fullstack AI engineer working across U.S. and European time zones from Maracay, Venezuela.
- Core services: AI agents and LLM features, full-stack product builds, third-party integrations and delivery.
- Author of open-source packages with 294K+ Dockershelf downloads and 60+ public GitHub projects.
- Tech stack: TypeScript, Python, Go, Node.js, FastAPI, Django, Docker, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.

## Case Studies

- Mash: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/mash — A desktop workspace for AI-assisted coding; terminal, editor and agents in one app, every tool pinned.
- Wholmaster: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/wholmaster — Offline gym management with biometric entrance, in daily use at one gym for over a year.
- Shoky Enterprise Harness: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/shoky — A forkable multi-repo agent workspace that about 25 engineers work from.
- Tetra Incubator system: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/tetra — A two-host agent incubator: 35 scheduled jobs and one human approver.
- The Writing Council: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/blog-system — Nine agents turn a premise into a sourced, published article under one byline.
- Botanas Benchmark: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/botanas — A trading research loop over Freqtrade built to refuse overfit strategies.
- Expedia API Integration: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/expedia — Booking engine integration work for Wheel The World.
- Wheel The World CI/CD: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/wheeltheworld — CI/CD reliability and cost optimization work.
- Soleit Desktop App: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/soleit — Electron and Ionic React diagnostic desktop application.
- Dockershelf: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/dockershelf — Lightweight Docker image catalog and automation.
- Canaima GNU/Linux: https://luisalejandro.org/case-studies/canaima — Linux distribution and public-sector free software work.
